description: This file is an HTML document containing embedded Common Lisp source code for the CodeMirror editor's Common Lisp mode. It includes Lisp functions for reading and writing integers and byte streams, along with associated macros and utility functions.

methods.name: integer-reader-name
methods.description: Generates the name of the function that reads integers of a specified byte size and signedness.

methods.name: integer-writer-name
methods.description: Generates the name of the function that writes integers of a specified byte size and signedness.

methods.name: integer-reader
methods.description: Creates a function to read integers of a given byte size from a binary stream.

methods.name: integer-writer
methods.description: Creates functions to write integers of a given byte size to a binary stream, both signed and unsigned.

methods.name: write-bytes
methods.description: Writes a byte array to a stream.

methods.name: write-str
methods.description: Writes a null-terminated string to a stream with optional UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: read-bytes
methods.description: Reads a sequence of bytes from a stream.

methods.name: read-str
methods.description: Reads a null-terminated string from a stream, handling UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: skip-bytes
methods.description: Skips a specified number of bytes in a stream.

methods.name: skip-str
methods.description: Skips a null-terminated string in a stream.

methods.name: ensure-socket-is-closed
methods.description: Ensures a socket stream is closed, handling errors during close.
